description: The Office of Congresswoman Andrea Salinas (D-OR-06) is seeking candidates for a full-time (40-hours a week) summer internship in our Washington D.C. office. Interns will get an in-depth look at the operations and functions of a congressional office, including policy, communications, office operations and constituent services.
